hero.subtitle: Imagine a day free of discomfort, where every movement flows with ease and you regain the joy of feeling your best. We turn this reality into your new normal.

about.title: Unlock the transformative potential of Specialized Physiotherapy.
about.intro: My name is Dra. Larissa Ramos, a physiotherapist graduated from UNINORTE - Manaus (CREFITO 10/279910-F), and for over {{years}} years I have dedicated my professional career to transforming lives through specialized rehabilitation.
about.mission: My mission is to guide you in overcoming physical limitations and achieving a pain-free life. Based on a precise diagnosis and individualized care, I structure treatments focused on real and lasting results.
about.conclusion: If you're looking for a dedicated, experienced physiotherapist passionate about helping people, schedule your consultation today!

services.title: Specialized Treatments
services.subtitle: Transform your well-being with a guided path towards relief, so you can enjoy every day with comfort and vitality.

spine_orthopedics.title: Spine & Orthopedics
spine_orthopedics.desc: Treatment of joint, muscle, and bone pain with an absolute focus on functional recovery and spine symptom relief.

surgery_rehab.title: Post-Surgical Rehabilitation
surgery_rehab.desc: Pre and post-surgical follow-up for knee injuries, with direct action and follow-up in surgeries with specialized medical teams.

sports.title: Sports Physiotherapy
sports.desc: Rehabilitation of athletes focused on rapid return to sports and injury prevention with Advanced Clinical Reasoning (ACR).

rca_mulligan.title: ACR & Mulligan Concept
rca_mulligan.desc: Innovative Advanced Clinical Reasoning techniques for the precise treatment of joint pain with immediate results.

manual_therapy.title: Manual & Myofascial Therapy
manual_therapy.desc: Trigger point release, tension relief, and improvement in joint mobility and muscle flexibility.

home_care.title: Home Care Physiotherapy
home_care.desc: Comfort and convenience with specialized care in the comfort of your home, ensuring the same clinical excellence. Complete portable equipment and personalized treatment dedicated to the Northern region of Florianópolis Island: Jurerê, Canasvieiras, Cachoeira do Bom Jesus, Ponta das Canas, Praia Brava, and nearby neighborhoods.
